name: International Stroke Conference 2027
organizer: American Stroke Association, a division of the American Heart Association
description: The International Stroke Conference is the annual scientific meeting of the American Stroke Association, a division of the American Heart Association, focused on cerebrovascular disease research and clinical stroke care. The 2027 conference runs February 10 to 12, 2027, in Houston, Texas, with pre-conference symposia held on February 9, 2027.
